32) In practice, the last list of seven continents is the one most widely adopted and used. DON’T MISS OUT You may have seen the five Olympic rings, one of the symbols of the Olympic Games. They symbolise the gathering of sportspeople from all over the world. The rings were chosen to represent five inhabited continents — Africa, America, Asia, Australia and Europe.
